summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist in monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with private helper _resolve_path, added explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py, added an autofunction docs section in docs/source/data.rst after the utils automodule, and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests).
